title: Blue Mountain Beach "Isla del Sol" 44 S. Grande Beach Dr.
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Isla del Sol" 44 S. Grande Beach Dr.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps from the Beach- Convenient Location- Private community beach access- 7 adult bikes- Community pool- 2 Balconies with Gulf views- Parking for 4 Vehicles- Newly Painted Interior/Exterior- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Isla del Sol is a stunning 7-bedroom, 6-bathroom house in the Blue Mountain Beach community of Scenic 30A that sleeps 18. This Gulf property offers stunning Emerald Coast views from the expansive upper-floor balconies and access to a community pool. Guests will love the quick walk to the nearest beach access!The first floor of this 3-story home blends indoor and outdoor living with a spacious bunk room boasting 2 twin-over-full beds and access to a beautiful patio. Use the propane grill to cook up a delicious feast before dining alfresco in the shade of palm trees. There's also a laundry room with a full-sized refrigerator on this floor for convenience. Isla del Sol provides ample space for large groups and families to gather on the main floor of this home. The great room features subtle coastal décor with white-washed wood and hints of sea blue. The kitchen boasts sleek black granite countertops and matching black appliances with blue cabinetry, bringing Gulf-inspired charm indoors. The kitchen island doubles as a breakfast bar and comfortably seats 4, which is great for morning coffee or afternoon snacks. The dining area, surrounded by windows and immense natural light, seats up to 12 guests at a time. In the living area, 2 plush couches, 2 matching armchairs, and a TV-facing layout makes it the ultimate spot for lounging. Guests can also access an outside balcony—perfect for sunrises or sunsets. There’s even a guest bedroom on this floor, making it an excellent option for those who want extra privacy at night. The top floor offers incredible comfort and relaxation with 3 bedrooms—1 primary bedroom with access to a private balcony and 2 guest bedrooms with access to an expansive shared balcony with lots of comfortable places to sit. Isla del Sol is the perfect mix of comfort and luxury. With on-site parking for 4 vehicles and 7 included adult bikes, it's easy to explore the nearby Timpoochee Trail or Point Washington State Forest. Enjoy fun in the sun at Isla del Sol! Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 18):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with ShowerTub Separate Nearby Attractions:Blue Mountain CreameryJustin Gaffrey Art Gallery30A multi-use Timpoochee TrailPoint Washington State ForestRed Fish Taco with Live MusicWeddings are not allowed at this home.
